feat: X-Teacher-ID header — get_current_teacher + require_teacher dependencies

refactor: teachers list — table with server-side search + pagination

Pagination is Previous/Next with page N of M counter, matching existing lesson-plans pattern. Build passes, 28/28 non-auth tests pass.

title: feat: auto-create client teacher on signup; remove teacher selector from LP page
feat: auto-create client teacher on signup; remove teacher selector from LP page

Webapp build passes, 0 TS errors.
